sloka: त्वं तु शक्र तदा नारीं जानीषे मनसा प्रभो ।स्थानाधिकतया पत्नी ममैषेति पुरन्दर ।। ७.३०.२७ ॥
transliteration: tvaṁ tu śakra tadā nārīṁ jānīṣe manasā prabho ।sthānādhikatayā patnī mamaiṣeti purandara ।। 7.30.27 ॥

translations.english: O Shakra, O Lord, O Purandara, you then mentally considered that woman to be your wife due to your superior position.
